digest.component_or_area: CI module-size gate and reconciler infrastructure
propositions: Module-size allowlist and ceilings files are orphaned after Phase 2a migrated to absolute cap; they must be deleted and removed from documentation
Three stale comments incorrectly state route_inbound_probe resides in reconcile.py when it now lives in reconcile_helpers.py and is re-exported
Module-size policy documentation must be updated to describe absolute 800 LOC cap, admin-locked limit in single source file, and removal of allowlist escape hatch
Test must be added to verify allowlist and ceilings files no longer exist and catch accidental reintroduction
Documentation references to module-size-allowlist must be pruned from architecture and agent docs
Comment corrections required in reconcile.py, run_differs.py, and apply_inbound.py to reflect reconcile module split
